meta.title: A closed RFQ: "Rejected Bids": "Close" closes it and changes nothing
gaps: Directly verify that all event status, schedule times, vendors, and bid details remain unchanged after closing the window.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Directly verify that all event status, schedule times, vendors, and bid details remain unchanged after closing the window.

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ on its Responses tab as the buyer.
Record the existing single vendor response before opening Rejected Bids.
Open the Rejected Bids window from the RFQ Settings menu.
Close the Rejected Bids window as required by the case.
Verify that the Rejected Bids window is no longer visible.
Verify the response count remains unchanged after closing the window.
Confirm the event screen remains rendered without errors or stale invalid content.
